v1/v2 reports preserved unchanged. No builds/tests/AST/lints/GPU/profiler/cleanup/Git commit/push/services performed. Main owns all qualification and ongoing separate source work.

Semantic correction: v1/v2 wrongly described ordinary serve's first emitted token as sampled from prefill outside ledger scope. Ordinary serve sp.run prefills n-1 conditioning tokens; the first T=1 verifier window processes final prompt token p=n-1 and generates first output. Scope is constructed before this loop. First window is included in ledger. Main supplied independently qualified GEN1/32768 evidence DONE1 with 480 lookups (48 layers x top10); no active receipt accessed by implementer. Scope/control flow in branch unchanged.

Coverage: preserve observed layer_calls and new fixed calls_by_layer[64], incremented only at completed valid dispatch hook. Shared checked host arithmetic calculates expected_layer_calls=layers*emitted only when layers1..64, emitted>=0 and uint64 multiplication safe. expected_calls_known reports arithmetic validity; it does not infer unseen routes. coverage_complete requires normal status length/stop, no invalid/overflow, matching observed total, and each layer observed exactly emitted calls. Cancellation/early close/failed windows/GPU callback shortcuts/mismatch keep coverage incomplete. Expected totals never replace observed route denominator. Actual layer_calls is the denominator. No whole-path bottleneck or exclusive timing conclusion from counters.

SOURCE fixtures added: normal GEN1 48 calls; GEN128 6144 calls; missing/extra calls; early close despite matching total; invalid flag; saturation/overflow flag; unsafe multiplication INT64_MAXx48; layers65 and negative emitted. Existing rawcapacity2/4 actualNT1 and bounds/NT/provider/extent/pointer/saturation fixture retained. No fixture executed.

All prior SPDX/rawcapacity correction retained. Ordinary rawspec4 noMTP/noSuffix/noLookup/noBatch singleGPU native GEN eligible; actual dispatch n_tok1 enforced. No numerics/routing/cache/capacity changes. State <=128KiB includes new512-byte perlayer counts; max2048 buckets/output512KiB. DefaultOFF no allocation/copy/timestamp; no new GPU wait/host-device atomic/per-job logging. Host writes after existing completion; close after wait_commit. Logical GU/Down/blob extents once/group, not physical DRAM/H2D; authoritative queued-copy bytes unavailable. Existing nested decode/pool intervals unchanged and not exclusive critical path.

Main validation plan: compile/run meaningful CPU fixture; source/full build; OFF/ON exact env and rawspec4 eligibility; normal GEN1 route-layer coverage; 32K diagnostic GEN coverage and actual emitted, parity/token fingerprint, normal close/fault checks; forced guards/reset/early close; bounds/overflow checks. Unchanged upstream bench.sh only for speed comparisons. No pass/speedup claim. Runtime/build unverified. perf_event_paranoid4 and ordinary serve's absent standalone profile_report exposure (Main supplied context) do not add any hardware profile evidence; no profiling performed.
